parts:
Hi Karen,

Do you have a file 'Mouse430_2.cdf' in the directory

xxx/annotationData/chipTypes/Mouse430_2/

where 'xxx' is your working directory for your R session? (you can find
this by typing getwd())

For example, my chip type is "HuEx-1_0-st-v2" and when I type 'getwd()'
I get,
> getwd()
[1] "C:/Documents and Settings/Elizabeth/My Documents/Research/ICBP/Exon
Array/Data"
and in the directory "C:/Documents and Settings/Elizabeth/My
Documents/Research/ICBP/Exon
Array/Data/annotationData/chipTypes/HuEx-1_0-st-v2", I have a file
"HuEx-1_0-st-v2.cdf".

Elizabeth
